subject: general
question: The perpendicular distance from the center of a circle to a chord is 5 { cm} . If the length of the chord is 24 { cm} , find the radius of the circle. Also, calculate the distance of another chord of length 18 { cm} from the center.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Radius (r), perpendicular distance (d), and half-chord (L/2) form a right-angled triangle. For Chord 1: L₁/2 = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm and d₁ = 5 cm. Using Pythagorean triplet (5, 12, 13), radius r = 13 cm. For Chord 2: L₂/2 = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm and r = 13 cm. Distance d₂ = √(13² − 9²) = √(169 − 81) = √88 = 2√22 cm. **∴ The correct answer is 13 cm, 2√22 cm.**
